articles.title: Who is favored to win the 2026 World Series? This is the clear favorite to win this year's championship
articles.standfirst: The Milwaukee Brewers will face either the Tampa Bay Rays or the Cleveland Guardians
articles.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers will face either the Tampa Bay Rays or the Cleveland Guardians
articles.body:
The Milwaukee Brewers are heading into the 2026 World Series after sweeping the defending champion Los Angeles Dodgers 4-0 in the National League Championship Series as their 6-4 victory on Thursday put them within reach of a long-awaited championship as the favorite. Milwaukee 's latest triumph was particularly impressive because the team recovered from a four-run deficit to eliminate Los Angeles as Garrett Mitchell delivered the go-ahead home run in the sixth inning before David Hamilton added another in the ninth on October 15.

Completing a comeback that matched the largest margin overturned to clinch a championship series, the Brewers will face either Cleveland or Tampa Bay , with the Guardians leading the Rays in the American League Championship Series 2-1. However, rain postponed Game 4, forcing the teams to adjust their schedule as Milwaukee prepares for its return to the Fall Classic – gaining another day of rest and planning over their rivals. The Brewers last appeared in the World Series in 1982, when they lost to the St. Louis Cardinals in seven games. Now, after finally overcoming the Dodgers , they have an opportunity to win the franchise's first championship.

Brewers backed for World Series win

Milwaukee will be favored against either potential opponent after its commanding performance against Los Angeles as the Brewers have a week to prepare for Game 1, scheduled for October 23 at American Family Field , while Cleveland and Tampa Bay continue their battle for the American League crown. The Guardians hold the advantage after winning Game 3 by a 3-2 score as Petey Halpin provided the decisive moment with a two-run home run against Tampa Bay , following it with a spectacular bat flip that captured the excitement surrounding Cleveland 's postseason run. Halpin 's contribution was another example of Cleveland finding timely production throughout the postseason as Jose Ramirez , Chase DeLauter , Josh Lowe and Jo Adell have also played important roles. At the same time, the Guardians ' pitching staff has consistently limited opposing offenses. Game 4 was rescheduled for Saturday at 20:00 ET/17:00 PT, with Game 5 moved to Sunday at 17:00 ET/14:00 PT. Games 6 and 7 will take place Monday and Tuesday at Tropicana Field if they are required, potentially forcing both teams to play four consecutive days ahead of the match-up with the Brewers . The Rays , meanwhile, must win the remaining games to prevent Cleveland from advancing to the World Series . Nick Martinez is starting for Tampa Bay and Shawn Armstrong opening a bullpen game for the Guardians .

articles.title: Where is the World Series 2026 being played? Every field that will host the games
articles.standfirst: The Milwaukee Brewers have secured their place in the Fall Classic after eliminating the defending champion Los Angeles Dodgers
articles.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have secured their place in the Fall Classic after eliminating the defending champion Los Angeles Dodgers
articles.body:
The countdown to the 2026 World Series is underway, and baseball fans already know one half of the matchup.

The Milwaukee Brewers have booked their place in the championship series after sweeping the Los Angeles Dodgers in the National League Championship Series, ending the defending champions' hopes of winning a third consecutive title.

The American League representative, however, remains undecided between the Tampa Bay Rays and Cleveland Guardians . Their best-of-seven ALCS is still in progress, meaning the final opponent for Milwaukee will depend on which team wins the remaining games.

One thing is already confirmed: the Brewers will have home-field advantage in the World Series, regardless of whether they face Tampa Bay or Cleveland.

That is because Milwaukee finished the regular season with a better record than either American League contender. The Brewers went 103-59, compared with the Rays' 98-64 and the Guardians' 85-77.

American Family Field will host the opening games

The 2026 World Series begins on Friday, October 23, at American Family Field in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The Brewers will host the first two games on their home turf before the series moves to the American League champion's stadium.

American Family Field, known for its retractable roof, has been the Brewers' home since 2001. The venue provides protection from the unpredictable late-October weather in Wisconsin, an important consideration for a championship series scheduled at the end of the baseball season.

Milwaukee's return to the World Series is particularly significant because the franchise has not appeared in the Fall Classic since 1982.

Back then, the team was competing in the American League and lost to the St. Louis Cardinals in seven games. Its 2026 National League pennant represents the second World Series appearance in franchise history.

The Brewers ' home advantage means they will also host Game 6 and Game 7 if the series lasts that long. Their supporters could therefore witness the franchise's first World Series championship at American Family Field if Milwaukee manages to win the final two games on its home field.

Which stadium will host the Rays or Guardians?

If Tampa Bay advances, the series will move to the Rays' home venue for Games 3, 4 and a potential Game 5. Those games are scheduled for October 26, 27 and 28, respectively.

If Cleveland wins the ALCS instead, the same three games will take place at the Guardians ' home stadium, Progressive Field, in downtown Cleveland.

The American League venue will host the middle portion of the series, giving the Rays or Guardians an opportunity to take advantage of their home crowd before the teams potentially return to Milwaukee.

The Rays ' home venue is Tropicana Field, which has been undergoing a return to use following damage caused by Hurricane Milton in 2024. The team's 2026 home games have been played there again after repairs.

Progressive Field, meanwhile, has been the Guardians' home since 1994 and is situated close to downtown Cleveland's other major sports venues.

Full 2026 World Series schedule and venues

Major League Baseball has announced the dates and first-pitch times for the potential seven-game series. All games are scheduled for 8 p.m. Eastern Time, with Games 5, 6 and 7 taking place only if necessary.

- Game 1 — Friday, October 23: American League champion at Milwaukee Brewers, American Family Field.

- Game 2 — Saturday, October 24: American League champion at Milwaukee Brewers, American Family Field.

- Game 3 — Monday, October 26: Milwaukee Brewers at American League champion, either Tropicana Field or Progressive Field.

- Game 4 — Tuesday, October 27: Milwaukee Brewers at American League champion, either Tropicana Field or Progressive Field.

- Game 5 — Wednesday, October 28 (if necessary): Milwaukee Brewers at American League champion, either Tropicana Field or Progressive Field.

- Game 6 — Friday, October 30 (if necessary): American League champion at Milwaukee Brewers, American Family Field.

- Game 7 — Saturday, October 31 (if necessary): American League champion at Milwaukee Brewers, American Family Field.

The schedule includes a travel day on Sunday, October 25, between Games 2 and 3, followed by another rest day on Thursday, October 29, if the series reaches Game 5.

What happened to the Dodgers?

Despite appearing in early predictions and bracket discussions, the Dodgers will not be playing in the 2026 World Series. Milwaukee eliminated Los Angeles with a four-game sweep in the NLCS, finishing the series with a 6-4 victory in Game 4.

The result ended the Dodgers ' bid for another championship and sent the Brewers to the Fall Classic for the first time in 44 years.

The only remaining uncertainty concerns Milwaukee's opponent. Cleveland and Tampa Bay are competing for the American League pennant, and their series will determine which stadium hosts Games 3 through 5.

For fans planning to attend, American Family Field is already confirmed as the location for the opening two games, with tickets being offered for potential World Series dates. The Brewers have warned that the inventory available for individual purchase is limited, reflecting the excitement around the team's historic return.

With the first pitch scheduled for October 23 and a possible Game 7 falling on Halloween, the 2026 World Series promises a dramatic end to the MLB season.

Milwaukee knows where it will play; baseball fans now await confirmation of which American League team will join the Brewers on the sport's biggest stage.

articles.title: How many games are played in the World Series? This is the format for the Fall Classic
articles.standfirst: The Milwaukee Brewers will take on either the Tampa Bay Rays or the Cleveland Guardians
articles.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers will take on either the Tampa Bay Rays or the Cleveland Guardians
articles.body:
The Milwaukee Brewers have secured their first World Series appearance since 1982, sweeping the Los Angeles Dodgers in the National League Championship Series as they will now await the winner of the Tampa Bay Rays and Cleveland Guardians . The 2026 Fall Classic begins Friday, October 23, with Milwaukee holding home-field advantage after finishing with the best regular-season record in Major League Baseball with 103 wins.

The championship will conclude the season with a best-of-seven series, meaning the first team to win four games will claim the title as the format rewards consistency across the regular season while giving both pennant winners an opportunity to compete for baseball's biggest prize. The series follows a 2-3-2 format, with the team holding home-field advantage hosting Games 1 and 2, then Games 6 and 7 if necessary. The opponent hosts Games 3, 4 and 5, giving the lower-seeded team three consecutive home games. Milwaukee earned home-field advantage by posting the best regular-season record in the league. That benefit applies regardless of whether Tampa Bay or Cleveland emerges from the American League , placing the Brewers in position to open the championship in front of their home supporters.

What is the 2026 World Series schedule?

Milwaukee now has a chance to win the franchise's first World Series championship after its only previous appearance ended in a seven-game defeat to the St. Louis Cardinals in 1982, when the Brewers competed in the American League . Their postseason run has already delivered a historic sweep of the defending champions and Shohei Ohtani , but four more victories are required to complete the journey and conclude a memorable year. The Brewers ' opponent will be confirmed once the American League Championship Series concludes. Tampa Bay and Cleveland remain in contention, with the winner earning the right to challenge baseball's regular-season leaders for the title. Game 1 is scheduled for Friday, October 23, with all seven potential games set to begin at 20:00 ET/17:00 PT. Every contest will be broadcast on FOX, allowing viewers to follow the championship throughout its scheduled run. The opening two games take place on Friday and Saturday before the series moves to the American League champion's home stadium for three consecutive games. After a scheduled day off on Thursday, October 29, the series would return to Milwaukee for Games 6 and 7 if the championship remains undecided. Below is the schedule: Game 1, Friday, October 23 : 20:00 ET/17:00 PT in Milwaukee Game 2, Saturday, October 24 : 20:00 ET/17:00 PT in Milwaukee Game 3, Monday, October 26 : 20:00 ET/17:00 PT in Cleveland/Tampa Bay Game 4, Tuesday, October 27 : 20:00 ET/17:00 PT in Cleveland/Tampa Bay Game 5, Wednesday, October 28 : 20:00 ET/17:00 PT *if necessary in Cleveland/Tampa Bay Game 6, Friday, October 30 : 20:00 ET/17:00 PT *if necessary in Milwaukee Game 7, Saturday, October 31 : 20:00 ET/17:00 PT *if necessary in Milwaukee

articles.title: How many times have the Brewers made it to the World Series? These are Milwaukee's World Series appearances
articles.standfirst: The Brewers' remarkable 2026 season has ended a decades-long drought, but their championship history holds a surprise
articles.summary: The Brewers' remarkable 2026 season has ended a decades-long drought, but their championship history holds a surprise
articles.body:
The Milwaukee Brewers have spent decades trying to get back to baseball's biggest stage, enduring playoff disappointments and near misses since their first World Series appearance in 1982.

That wait has finally ended in 2026, with Milwaukee securing the National League pennant after a dominant postseason performance that followed the most successful regular season in franchise history.

Under manager Pat Murphy , the Brewers won 103 games during the regular season before completing a four-game sweep in the National League Championship Series.

Their return to the Fall Classic marks a significant achievement for a franchise that has established itself as a consistent postseason contender without managing to secure baseball's ultimate prize.

Milwaukee has now reached the World Series twice, although its first appearance ended in a defeat that still resonates more than four decades later.

When did Milwaukee Brewers last play in the World Series?

Milwaukee's only previous World Series appearance came in 1982, when the Brewers were members of the American League and possessed one of baseball's most dangerous lineups.

That team, famously nicknamed "Harvey's Wallbangers" after manager Harvey Kuenn , featured future Hall of Famers Robin Yount and Paul Molitor , alongside offensive standout Cecil Cooper .

The Brewers finished the regular season with a 95-67 record, scoring 891 runs before defeating the California Angels in the American League Championship Series.

Their reward was a World Series meeting with the St. Louis Cardinals , who pushed Milwaukee into a fiercely contested seven-game championship showdown.

Milwaukee appeared close to securing its first title after taking a 3-2 series lead, but St. Louis recovered to win the final two games.

The Cardinals claimed Game 7 by a 6-3 score, leaving the Brewers one victory short of becoming world champions.

How Milwaukee finally returned to World Series in 2026

The years following that defeat brought several opportunities for Milwaukee to challenge for another pennant, although none resulted in a World Series appearance until 2026.

The Brewers reached the National League Championship Series in 2011, losing to St. Louis in six games, before another opportunity slipped away against the Los Angeles Dodgers in seven games in 2018.

More recently, Milwaukee suffered a four-game NLCS sweep in 2025, despite finishing the regular season with 97 victories.

However, the Brewers responded impressively in 2026, improving their record to 103-59 and completing an unbeaten NLCS to secure their first National League pennant.

The achievement also means Milwaukee has reached the World Series representing both leagues, having moved from the American League to the National League in 1998.

Have the Milwaukee Brewers ever won World Series?

Despite reaching the championship series in 1982 and 2026, Milwaukee has never won a World Series title.

The franchise originally entered Major League Baseball as the Seattle Pilots in 1969 before relocating to Milwaukee the following year.

Its 2026 breakthrough offers another chance to change that history and establish a new standard for one of baseball's longest-established franchises without a championship.

The 1982 team remains celebrated in Milwaukee, but Murphy's current roster now has an opportunity to accomplish something even that legendary lineup could not.

After 44 years of waiting, the Brewers are no longer chasing another World Series appearance. They are chasing their first World Series championship.

articles.title: Where to watch Rays vs Brewers? Schedule and TV channel for game 3 of the 2026 World Series
articles.standfirst: Milwaukee holds on for the final out: the Brewers edge the Rays 5-4 in a battle of nerves
articles.summary: Two franchises chase their first championship as the Fall Classic opens in Milwaukee on Friday, October 23
articles.body:
A new World Series champion will be crowned in 2026, and the journey began Friday when the Milwaukee Brewers welcome the Tampa Bay Rays to American Family Field for Game 1.

The matchup brings together the top seeds from both leagues, with Milwaukee returning to the World Series for the first time since 1982 and Tampa Bay making its third appearance.

Milwaukee enters the series following a franchise-record 103 regular-season victories and a commanding National League Championship Series sweep of the Los Angeles Dodgers .

The Rays , meanwhile, eliminated the New York Yankees before defeating the Cleveland Guardians in six games to secure the American League pennant.

With neither club having previously won the championship, the seven-game series guarantees a first-time winner.

What time is Rays vs Brewers Game 1 and what channel is it on?

Game 3 of the 2026 World Series takes place this Monday, October 26, at American Family Field in Milwaukee, with first pitch scheduled for 8:00 PM ET (7:00 p.m. Central Time and 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time)

FOX will broadcast the game nationally across the United States, while FOX One will provide a streaming option.

Spanish-language coverage will be available through FOX Deportes, with Univision also televising Friday's opening game.

ESPN Radio will provide national radio commentary, while TUDN Radio will carry Spanish-language broadcasts throughout the series.

MLB.TV subscribers can also watch the FOX broadcasts by authenticating an eligible subscription with a participating television provider.

Game 2 will follow Saturday, October 24, with another 8:00 PM ET start before the teams travel to Tampa Bay.

Full 2026 World Series schedule and TV channels

All seven possible games are scheduled for 8:00 PM ET (7:00 PM CT / 5:00 PM PT), with FOX providing national television coverage throughout the Fall Classic.

Game 4: Tuesday, October 27 – Milwaukee Brewers at Tampa Bay Rays – 8:00 PM ET

Game 5*: Wednesday, October 28 – Milwaukee Brewers at Tampa Bay Rays – 8:00 PM ET

Game 6*: Friday, October 30 – Tampa Bay Rays at Milwaukee Brewers – 8:00 PM ET

Game 7*: Saturday, October 31 – Tampa Bay Rays at Milwaukee Brewers – 8:00 PM ET

Games 5, 6 and 7 will be played only if necessary. All games are scheduled to air on FOX, FOX One and FOX Deportes.

World Series Game 2: Standings and Results

On a postseason night where every inning felt like a heavy burden, the Milwaukee Brewers edged the Tampa Bay Rays 5–4 in front of 43,245 fans at American Family Field. The team with the best record in all of baseball during the regular season once again demonstrated why they entered October with that distinction: winning a tight contest—the kind decided by a single pitch or a split-second decision—is precisely what separates true contenders from mere participants. The final score tells only part of the story. The Rays, champions of the American League East with 98 wins, made more solid contact—collecting 11 hits to Milwaukee’s 7—and drew 5 walks, keeping the pressure on the home team’s pitching staff all night. The problem for Tampa Bay was the arithmetic of missed opportunities: they left runners stranded on the basepaths throughout the game and never managed to fully capitalize. Milwaukee, by contrast, made every at-bat count. Despite having fewer hits, the Brewers posted superior offensive efficiency numbers: a .306 batting average, a .390 on-base percentage (OBP), and an .807 OPS—well above the visitors’ .219/.286/.661. When it came to driving in runs with men in scoring position, it was the home team that delivered. If there was one factor that explains the outcome, it was the pitching. Milwaukee’s staff covered all 9 innings with a 3.00 ERA, allowing only 3 earned runs while racking up 10 strikeouts—a massive statistic in a high-stakes, do-or-die game. Those ten strikeouts snuffed out rallies just as the Rays threatened to break the game open. Tampa Bay, for its part, paid a steep price: a 5.625 ERA over 8 innings of work, with 5 earned runs charged to their account. Both teams hit one home run apiece, but it was the little things—a timely strikeout, a ground ball turned into a double play, a walk avoided—that tipped the scales in favor of the home side. Defensively, the Brewers were also flawless when it mattered most, recording 10 assists and committing no errors that would have gifted outs to their opponent.

What to expect from the 2026 World Series

The Brewers enter the championship series with momentum after eliminating the defending champion Dodgers , supported by a bullpen that has produced a 1.33 ERA across eight postseason appearances.

Jackson Chourio, William Contreras and Brice Turang provide important offensive options, while Milwaukee's pitching depth has proved decisive throughout October.

Tampa Bay will counter with a starting rotation featuring Drew Rasmussen, Freddy Peralta and Nick Martinez , supported by an offense led by Junior Caminero, Yandy Diaz and Jonathan Aranda .

The Rays are seeking redemption after losing the World Series in 2008 and 2020, while Milwaukee hopes to complete a championship journey that has eluded the organization for more than four decades.

MLB.TV subscribers can also watch the FOX broadcasts by authenticating an eligible subscription with a participating television provider.
Game 2 will follow Saturday, October 24, with another 8:00 PM ET start before the teams travel to Tampa Bay.
Full 2026 World Series schedule and TV channels
All seven possible games are scheduled for 8:00 PM ET (7:00 PM CT / 5:00 PM PT), with FOX providing national television coverage throughout the Fall Classic.
Game 4: Tuesday, October 27 – Milwaukee Brewers at Tampa Bay Rays – 8:00 PM ET
Game 5*: Wednesday, October 28 – Milwaukee Brewers at Tampa Bay Rays – 8:00 PM ET
Game 6*: Friday, October 30 – Tampa Bay Rays at Milwaukee Brewers – 8:00 PM ET
Game 7*: Saturday, October 31 – Tampa Bay Rays at Milwaukee Brewers – 8:00 PM ET
Games 5, 6 and 7 will be played only if necessary. All games are scheduled to air on FOX, FOX One and FOX Deportes.
World Series Game 2: Standings and Results

On a postseason night where every inning felt like a heavy burden, the Milwaukee Brewers edged the Tampa Bay Rays 5–4 in front of 43,245 fans at American Family Field. The team with the best record in all of baseball during the regular season once again demonstrated why they entered October with that distinction: winning a tight contest—the kind decided by a single pitch or a split-second decision—is precisely what separates true contenders from mere participants. The final score tells only part of the story. The Rays, champions of the American League East with 98 wins, made more solid contact—collecting 11 hits to Milwaukee’s 7—and drew 5 walks, keeping the pressure on the home team’s pitching staff all night. The problem for Tampa Bay was the arithmetic of missed opportunities: they left runners stranded on the basepaths throughout the game and never managed to fully capitalize. Milwaukee, by contrast, made every at-bat count. Despite having fewer hits, the Brewers posted superior offensive efficiency numbers: a .306 batting average, a .390 on-base percentage (OBP), and an .807 OPS—well above the visitors’ .219/.286/.661. When it came to driving in runs with men in scoring position, it was the home team that delivered. If there was one factor that explains the outcome, it was the pitching. Milwaukee’s staff covered all 9 innings with a 3.00 ERA, allowing only 3 earned runs while racking up 10 strikeouts—a massive statistic in a high-stakes, do-or-die game. Those ten strikeouts snuffed out rallies just as the Rays threatened to break the game open. Tampa Bay, for its part, paid a steep price: a 5.625 ERA over 8 innings of work, with 5 earned runs charged to their account. Both teams hit one home run apiece, but it was the little things—a timely strikeout, a ground ball turned into a double play, a walk avoided—that tipped the scales in favor of the home side. Defensively, the Brewers were also flawless when it mattered most, recording 10 assists and committing no errors that would have gifted outs to their opponent.
What to expect from the 2026 World Series
The Brewers enter the championship series with momentum after eliminating the defending champion Dodgers , supported by a bullpen that has produced a 1.33 ERA across eight postseason appearances.
Jackson Chourio, William Contreras and Brice Turang provide important offensive options, while Milwaukee's pitching depth has proved decisive throughout October.
Tampa Bay will counter with a starting rotation featuring Drew Rasmussen, Freddy Peralta and Nick Martinez , supported by an offense led by Junior Caminero, Yandy Diaz and Jonathan Aranda .
The Rays are seeking redemption after losing the World Series in 2008 and 2020, while Milwaukee hopes to complete a championship journey that has eluded the organization for more than four decades.

articles.title: On the brink: Brewers’ historic 8-run, 2-out surge leaves Rays' World Series hopes in ruins
articles.standfirst: Milwaukee breaks an MLB postseason record with seven straight 2-out hits in a brutal 10-1 rout, pushing Tampa Bay to the verge of elimination
articles.summary: Milwaukee breaks an MLB postseason record with seven straight 2-out hits in a brutal 10-1 rout, pushing Tampa Bay to the verge of elimination
articles.body:
Taylor Walls stabbed at Brice Turang 's sharp grounder and felt it glance off his glove. “ Knife in the chest ,” the Tampa Bay Rays shortstop said. Tampa Bay's first World Series game at Tropicana Field in 18 years turned into a record-setter for Brewers batters.

Milwaukee became the first team to score eight runs with two outs in a World Series inning, routing the Rays 10-1 on Monday night to take a 3-0 lead in the best-of-seven series.

Turang's two-run single was the second of a postseason-record seven straight two-out hits against starter Freddy Peralta and relievers Cam Booser and Cole Sulser .

Milwaukee turned a 2-0 lead into a 7-0 advantage with hits on three straight pitches by Turang, Garrett Mitchell and Cooper Pratt. The Brewers went on to score eight runs in a 17-pitch span to open a 10-run advantage . Jackson Chourio had a single and a double in the inning, part of his four-hit night.

"Worst feeling in the world, feeling like you let your team down,” a downcast Booser said in the quiet Tampa Bay clubhouse.

Among 25 previous teams that fell behind 3-0 in a World Series, 21 were swept and four lost in five games. Of 43 teams to trail 3-0 in any best-of-seven postseason matchup , only the Boston Red Sox against the New York Yankees in the 2004 American League Championship Series rebounded to win.

“It’s kind of that chip and a chair mentality," Rays manager Kevin Cash said. “ We’ve got a seat at the table . We’ve got to do something with the chip. Obviously the only thing we can do is win tomorrow.”

Coming off a pair of one-run wins at American Family Field , the Brewers took a 2-0 lead in the third when Christian Yelich and William Contreras hit opposite-field, one-out RBI singles on consecutive pitches.

“They were very disciplined at the plate,” Peralta said. “ Just tried to hit the ball the other way .”

Chourio singled with one out in the fifth and Christian Yelich walked with two outs. Contreras grounded to third and Junior Caminero threw to second as umpire Dan Bellino signaled a forceout. But the call was reversed in the New York replay operations center by umpire Alfonso Márquez, giving Contreras an infield single that loaded the bases.

Caminero may have had a better chance of throwing out Contreras at first base. “I knew the speed at first base wasn’t necessarily the best in that situation,” Caminero said through a translator. “ So going into the moment , once I got the groundball I was going to second base all the way.”

Booser relieved and Turang’s 106 mph one-hopper hit the dirt just past the infield grass, bounced off Walls' glove and into short center field.

“ I’d like to have that one back . Those are plays that you’d like to make, that you expect to make even though they may be on the tougher end,” Walls said. “That was pretty much the turning point in the game there.”

Walls dropped to a knee and held out his glove at shoulder level trying to make what would have been an excellent stop, then tumbled as the ball bounced past him .

“You just try to get your eyes as close to where the ball is going to be, the height of the hop,” he said. “ Ideally, I guess if you want to talk about fractions , if you can get your glove behind the ball and work more backwards you have a better chance to make the play than if you’re slightly above it having to kind of work down a little bit, which is where I kind of felt I was.”

Mitchell grounded an opposite-field RBI single through the shortstop hole vacated with Walls shifted toward second for the left-handed batter. Pratt followed with a smash off the glove of a diving Caminero that rolled into the left-field corner for a two-run double .

Sal Frelick sliced an opposite-field double that hit the wall on a hop in the left-field corner, scoring Pratt and chasing Booser.

David Hamilton greeted Sulser by lining a shoulder-high fastball into center for a run-scoring single and a 9-0 lead. Chourio then lofted an opposite-field RBI double that hit just in front of the warning track.

Boston set the previous Series high of seven runs with two outs in the fifth inning of the 2007 opener against Colorado , a feat matched three years later by San Francisco in the eighth inning of Game 2 against Texas, according to the Elias Sports Bureau. The Los Angeles Dodgers were the only prior team with eight two-out runs in any postseason inning, scoring 10 with two outs in the first inning of Game 3 against Atlanta in the 2020 NL Championship Series.

Griffin Jax said he'll put the Series deficit out of his mind when he starts Game 4 on Tuesday.

“We just got our butts kicked tonight. I don’t think there’s really much else to say,” Jax explained. “We’ll just kind of forget it and try to sleep it off and come back tomorrow ready to fight.”
